title: Pre-existing clippy warning: needless_borrows_for_generic_args in metadata-types test
description:
crate-jmap-metadata-types/tests/metadata_types.rs:195 fails 'cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings' with:

    error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
    let round_trip = serde_json::to_value(&Metadata::Annotation(ann)).unwrap();
                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args (rust 1.95.0 lint).

Fix: drop the leading & from the argument. Discovered while running workspace clippy for JMAP-tjvm.5; pre-existing on commit e335675, unrelated to that work.
